rothstein.desk_empty.how: clerk mask + generous head polygon + left-arm polygon, dilated 21 px. Rows y<1935: same-row transplant from the right (cupboard base, counter edge). Rows 1935..2665: periodic tiling of the clean wainscot strip x1560-2120 in whole plank periods (143 px, autocorrelation, tile 429 px). Each counter-row run is tone-ramped to the photo on both sides of the hole on its row. Desk top: Telea low band + same-photo grain. 6 px seam blend.

rothstein.full_levelled.how: the whole raster with its one levels curve (for any further crop)

fingers.note: source shows the pencil fist with 3 curled fingers + thumb; notches between knuckles kept

pencil_to_chin.note: positive = clockwise on screen (y down). Residual is radial: close it by sliding the arm piece along the shoulder->chin line (scapula shrug) or by the 2-bone split below.

handmade: Seeds and contour markup (box + scribble polygons, hair ellipse, pencil line, FK split polygons) authored in cutouts/build/pieces.py

Repairs: Telea low band + native grain transplanted from the same photograph (no synthetic noise): shirt under the arm, pencil strip on the temple, fist edge over the ear, dial under the clock hands, glass behind the lamp
Empty-desk plate: same-row texture transplant (counter rows from the right; beadboard rows shifted by whole plank periods) + Telea/grain on the desk top
Scissor margins baked by bake_margin() at ~8 px page scale (*.margin.png); the white is paper (247,246,242), not a glow
absences: No second photograph of the Randolph agent exists online: LoC FSA negatives 8b16701-8b16715 (the Randolph/Vermont run) were looked at; none shows the agent again. So no real 'looking up' head of the same man. Offered: bubley82.agent.head (a matched FSA agent, level sideways gaze) as a declared Gilliam substitution, or keep the Rothstein head with the collar hinge.

Searched LoC FSA for a matched agent looking UP (queries: clerk, looking up, puzzled, thinking, station agent, head scratching). Closest: Delano 1943 Parmelee passenger agent (2017843893) looks up but wears a uniform cap and dark coat: rejected (does not match the bare-headed clerk).
No room door in the Randolph frame: the SERVICE door is the cupboard's right leaf (declared).
Moving Image Archive stills for clock/key: only 320x240 colour or mixed frames, too small for a 3300-px page; none used. LoC (same photographer, same trip, 1937) supplied the clock instead.

Rothstein master: not re-fetched. The test shot's multi-range reassembly (every 3rd row/col, 4360x3100 of rows 300-9600, cols 480-13560) was reused after an orientation/registration check against 8b16710v.jpg (see sources.rothstein.orientation_check). The trimmed margins are film rebate and the KODAK edge print, not picture.
Sound was not foraged by this unit (assigned to rig-animator).
known_defects: rothstein.desk_empty: the filled silhouette reads as a dark chair-back shape against the tiled wainscot; a smear remains at the ledger's left corner where his forearm lay. Frame P2 so the ledger corner sits under the departing clerk or a panel edge.
rothstein.window: a faint soft patch remains right of the TICKET arrow where the lamp shade was removed; the lamp piece is laid back over it at rest, so it only shows mid-sway.
rothstein.cupboard (closed) still has the clerk's head at its lower left; use rothstein.desk_empty or the cupboard_door for clean pieces.

rothstein.clerk.head: the hair top over the dark cupboard is a hand-drawn contour (ellipse), not GrabCut; the head is cut at the collar with a little shirt collar attached so the collar hinge reads as overlapping paper.

Tone: the torso piece is 75% L>220 (the shirt clips to paper white by design); the window plate is dark (median 74), so P4/P6 need the white balloon, glass reflections and the racks/papers to carry the high-key share.

pencil_to_chin: rotating pencil_arm about the shoulder by about -30 degrees brings the pencil to the chin's bearing, but 142 px too far out. Close the gap with the elbow split (forearm_pencil) or by sliding the arm 140 px along the shoulder-to-chin line.
